Requires Attunement by a character with renown in the Ashen Verdict.

This thick metal band bears a skull whose eyes are two luminous blue gems. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent, a stylized O, is stamped inside it.

While wearing this ring, you gain the following benefits (Ashen Verdict renown required in parentheses).

Destruction (Uncommon, Renown 3+). You gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls, and your spell save DC increases by 1.

Greater Destruction (Rare, Renown 10+). The bonus to spell attack rolls and the increase to your spell save DC become +2.

Unmatched Destruction (Very Rare, Renown 25+). The bonus and the increase become +3. In addition, you can treat any 1 you roll on a damage die of a spell you cast as a 2.

Endless Destruction (Legendary, Renown 50+). In addition to the Very Rare benefits, your spellcasting ability score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30, and you can add a +3 bonus to one damage roll of each spell you cast.

Foundry Note

For the Endless tier, turn on the effect of your spellcasting ability only.
